_about: Press, reviews, and coverage of the Goran Ivanovic Group / Eastern Blok (2004-2012). Pull quotes only, never full text. verified=true means the page text was read on the accessed date; false means the item is known only from a search snippet or the band's own promo copy. Null dates are unknown, not forgotten. Field names follow press/SCHEMA.md (origin/better-than-tv-reviews-2026-10-04). namesDoug is true only where the page text read names him; false means not confirmed. approved stays false until Doug OKs an entry for the site.

entries.title: Eastern Blok (band-supplied biography)
pullQuotes: relentlessly innovative work (Los Angeles Times)
the ensemble playing is often breakneck and consistently challenging (Downbeat)
blazing virtuosity and sheer beauty (Acoustic Guitar)

The original LA Times, Downbeat, Acoustic Guitar, and Minor 7th pieces are NOT located; do not publish these quotes on the site as verified until they are. The same bio mentions NPR, Chicago Public Radio's Chicago Undercover, the 2005 John Lennon Songwriting Competition finalist, and the film Wanted.

entries.title: The Reader's Guide to the World Music Festival

pullQuotes: display an impressive mastery of the disparate genres that inform Ivanovic's tunes
a proggy fussiness
entries.notes: Short blurb in the Reader's World Music Festival guide (Chicago, Sept 14-20, 2007), on the 'brand-new Folk Tales'. Mixed: praises the players' command of the styles, but says they too often play with a 'proggy fussiness' that makes it hard to enjoy. Author initials from the page; the festival guide runs under several writers, so confirm Margasak. Both quotes are trimmed.

entries.title: Eastern Blok, Folk Tales
entries.author: Patrick Ragains
pullQuotes: The band sounds spontaneous and live on this well-balanced recording.
Eastern Blok should have a bright future.

Also quotes DownBeat second-hand: 'offers up fire rather than ice, and the guitarist's amalgamation of flamenco, Balkan, classical, blues, and jazz keeps his band pushing forward almost all of the time.' That is probably from DownBeat's 2006 review of the first album (see downbeat-goran-ivanovic-group-2006-06). Calls the leader 'Serbian transplant'.

entries.title: JazzPRESS, October 2012: interview with Matt Ulery (Wywiady, pp. 78-80)
entries.author: Interviewer signed "RG" (full name not captured)
pullQuotes: (translated from Polish) "Part of the music was written by Goran Ivanovic, and part is mine."
entries.notes: Not a review: an interview with bassist Matt Ulery in the Polish web magazine's October 2012 issue (113-page PDF). Pages 78 and 80 discuss Eastern Blok: Ulery says the band listened to a lot of Balkan, Russian and Polish folk music when it started, and that Underwater was recorded in a Chicago studio with engineer Anthony Gravino (who made all his records) and is 'my second self'. The interviewer admits he has not yet heard Underwater. Translations are by Claude, not the publisher; check the Polish before quoting. Doug Rosenberg is not named on the pages found.

entries.title: Goran Ivanovic Group, 3 stars
entries.author: Mitch Myers
pullQuotes: saxophonist Doug Rosenberg serves well as his instrumental foil.
entries.notes: Only source is Doug's own old press page as captured by Wayback (2017). Taken from press/candidates.json (another session's index, 2026-10-05), not checked by me. The original DownBeat page or issue is not located. The first real DownBeat review of the band; the 2008 promo bio's DownBeat quote ('breakneck and consistently challenging') may come from a later review, since this quote differs. Star rating shown as 3 of 5 per that index.

entries.title: DownBeat, January 2013 (mention)
entries.notes: DownBeat January 2013 issue (a Scribd copy). Snippet reads 'In the quartet Eastern Blok with guitarist Goran Ivanovic, all of the compositions are tied to Balkan traditions.' Probably in a feature on Matt Ulery. Seen only as a Google result titled 'Downbeat-January2013' on Scribd; the link was not captured. This is the first confirmed DownBeat mention; the page and author need finding, and it is a mention, not a review.

entries.title: Goran Ivanovic Group (AllMusic review by Chris Nickson)
entries.author: Chris Nickson
pullQuotes: a killer jazz disc
has far more in common with jazz than its roots
entries.notes: Staff review read in Chrome. Mixed-to-positive: praises Ivanovic's inventive guitar and the writing, but warns that listeners wanting gypsy music will not get it. No publication date on the page. The star rating is graphical and was not captured; check the page. Page lists the album as 2005, recorded July 2005 at B-Side Audio. The AllMusic page for Folk Tales shows no review. Does not name Doug in the text read.

entries.title: Meet Croatian-born guitarist Goran Ivanovic from Chicago

gigLog._about: Dated shows of the Goran Ivanovic Group / Eastern Blok, taken from the titles of fan recordings in the Internet Archive Live Music Archive (taper Brian Skalinder and others), pulled 2026-10-05 via archive.org advancedsearch. Title metadata only; no audio or text copied. The search reported 75 results but only about 50 were readable and many were duplicate formats, so this list is incomplete. Archive page for any entry: https://archive.org/details/<archiveId>. Dates and venues are as the uploaders titled them and are not independently confirmed.

gaps: HotHouse (31 E. Balbo, Chicago) searched 2026-10-05: no review of a show there found. Evidence of shows: recordings of 2005-06-24 and 2006-12-15, a 2004-03-12 Reader listing (with Shooglenifty), and Goran's January 2001 solo show. The Chicago Bar Project memorial page does not mention the band.

No college newspaper article found for any campus stop (searched 2026-10-05: Daily Princetonian, Michigan Daily, Cornell Daily Sun, Fredonia Leader, The Gateway, Daily Illini). Google's index of old student papers is patchy, so this does not prove none exist. Check each paper's own archive search and Wayback.

No professional review of Underwater found after Google, Bing, and several search-tool queries (2026-10-04). Rate Your Music shows no reviews. Only previews, a release-party listing, and one forum comment exist.
Underwater release year unclear: 2011 per most listings, but a St. Louis listing calls the 2012-05-17 show a release celebration.
No post-show concert reviews found, only previews and one fan recording.

Out-of-town venue and local-paper searches run 2026-10-05 (Boston, Cleveland, Pittsburgh, Cincinnati, Cedar Rapids, Iowa City, Denver, Fort Collins, Milwaukee, Madison, St. Louis, Toledo, Binghamton, Philadelphia, NYC): no local paper review or preview found. The search tool returns few local-paper pages, so this is not proof. Not yet tried: each paper's own archive search.

Minor 7th quote in the bio is now sourced (James Scott, Nov/Dec 2005). Original LA Times and Acoustic Guitar pieces, and the DownBeat 'breakneck and consistently challenging' line, still not located; the DownBeat 'fire rather than ice' quote is only second-hand via Minor 7th.
AllMusic page for the Goran Ivanovic Group album blocked (403); unknown whether it has a review.

Chicago Reader searched 2026-10-05 (Google site: and search tool). Found the 2007 Folk Tales blurb, a 2008 blog preview, a 2009 listing, and 2004 gig listings; no Reader review of Underwater or the Goran Ivanovic Group album found. The Reader's own archive search was not run.
Not yet searched: Amazon/CD Baby customer reviews, Time Out Chicago, Chicago Tribune, Sun-Times archives, print-only coverage, Doug's own press-kit files.

Chicago Reader archive searched 2026-10-23 through its WordPress API and site search (terms: "Eastern Blok", Ivanovic, "Ivanovic Group", Doug Rosenberg). The Reader's current site has only about a dozen pages naming the band for 2004-2012, mostly bare listings; the weekly club listings after 2005 (Katerina's, Martyrs', Double Door, Metro, Hideout, Jazz Showcase, Mayne Stage) are not on it. The old chicagoreader.com/chicago/.../Event?oid= pages survive only in the Wayback Machine, which was offline on 2026-10-23.
Pages that block the fetch tool but open in Chrome (Cloudflare): worldmusiccentral.org, allaboutjazz.com, jazznearyou.com. fredonia.edu returns Access Denied in Chrome too.

Campus and school papers searched 2026-10-23: found The Tartan (CMU) photo caption for 2008-03-22 and the Princeton Weekly Bulletin calendar for 2008-03-24. No hits: Cornell Daily Sun archive ("Eastern Blok", "Ivanovic balkan"), CMU digital collections for "Goran Ivanovic" (only the one issue), Wilmette Public Library local history (covers New Trier), Daily Illini WordPress search, Columbia Chronicle WordPress search, the-tartan.org (current site). NOT searched because the archives sit behind a Cloudflare "verify you are human" check: Illinois Digital Newspaper Collections (Daily Illini 2008-10-10 Krannert) and the Michigan Daily archive at Bentley (2007-03-16, 2008-03-31, 2010-08-14 Ann Arbor). Doug can run those two by hand. Student papers with no searchable archive found: Haverford, Truman State, Grand Valley (see lanthorn-founders-2007-02), Binghamton, Ithaca, Omaha Gateway, Elgin, Fredonia (page itself denied). High school papers (Schaumburg, New Trier, Trumansburg, Kennedy, Mt. Anthony) turned up nothing.

The band's own 2008 Press and News pages (easternblok.net, Wayback 2008-06-09 and 2008-08-28, saved in press-archive/easternblok-net-site/) were the best source of leads: they list the PLAYBACK:stl, CS Magazine, Tollbooth, Bi-College News, WSKG, Resident Media Pundit, Radio Muse and Revue Magazine items now in this file. Earlier sessions had read only the 2007 press page. The 2011-2012 versions of the site have no press page capture.

Amazon pages for all three albums checked 2026-10-23 in Chrome: Goran Ivanovic Group has 3 customer reviews, Folk Tales 1, Underwater none. Campus archives searched in Chrome with no CAPTCHA this time: Illinois Digital Newspaper Collections (no hits for "Eastern Blok", "Goran Ivanovic"; its Daily Illini coverage may not reach 2007-2008) and the Michigan Daily Digital Archives (no hits). AllMusic has only the 2005 album page (already in this file). chamber-music.org still fails with a certificate error and was not bypassed.

Snarky Puppy tours (2008-10 and 2011-03/04) searched 2026-10-23: the band's own calendars and Snarky Puppy's 2011 blog give the dates, but no newspaper, blog or student-paper coverage of the Eastern Blok sets turned up (searched Chicago, Louisville, Denton, Dallas, New Orleans, Hattiesburg, Madison and Milwaukee outlets reachable by the search tool). Not reachable: Louisville Courier-Journal, Hattiesburg American, Milwaukee Journal Sentinel, Chicago Tribune (blocked to the search tool). Try Snarky Puppy's tour-wrap blog posts for April 2011 (not in Wayback), LEO Weekly and Daily Cardinal archives by hand, and ask Michael League or Zach Brock for photos and clippings.
